currentArchitectureFindings: The map is a single persistent floating iframe ('MountStage' class in web/app.js:316-472), shared machinery for three stages: map, review (Plan review), files (Smart Files). States are collapsed/presented/max, driven by [data-stage-present]/[data-stage-max] buttons. Currently only Expand (presented) and Full (max) buttons exist; Dock is reached implicitly by re-clicking the active button or Escape, not an explicit third control.

presented and max both trigger a background 'recede' (scale 1.03 + dim to brightness 0.72) and a scrim + Escape affordance (web/app.js:491-523) shared across all three stages. The approved Full.dc.html and Expand.dc.html mockups show the left nav, top bar and lens tabs fully undimmed with the surrounding layout reflowed in place -- not a dimmed floating modal. This means map's presented/max behavior needs to diverge from review/files' shared modal behavior, which must not regress (Plan review and Smart Files still use the floating/scrim pattern and are out of scope).

The map iframe src is /property-map.html?cityKey=... (src/compose.mjs:269), field name 'smartsite.url' is legacy naming from the pre-G-117 SmartSite embed but now points at the native Leaflet page (G-117).

CRITICAL GAP: property detail (zoning/flood/setbacks/buildable-area), 'on this parcel' records, and the 52-layer panel are ALL rendered INSIDE web/property-map.html/.js today -- a fully self-contained page with its own search form, its own fetch to GET /api/property-map/summary (src/server.mjs:315, calling composePropertyIntelSummary in src/property-map.mjs), and its own dark-only pm-* styling that does not share the sc-kit design system. There is no postMessage bridge between the iframe and the parent shell (grepped web/property-map.js for postMessage: no matches) and no property-intel data in the shell's own compose() payload (grepped src/compose.mjs: no matches for composePropertyIntelSummary/propertyIntel).

The approved mockups render property detail and 'On this parcel' records as shell-native sc-kit-styled <section> panels beside a plain map, for a fixed example parcel (908 PINE ST, 48021:34137). Implementing that as drawn requires either (a) the shell fetching /api/property-map/summary itself for the current/gold parcel and rendering its own panels (map iframe narrows to just the Leaflet canvas), with click-to-select sync deferred, or (b) a new postMessage bridge for live click-driven sync. The dispatch does not say which; the mockups only show one static populated parcel, which reads as (a). Flagging rather than assuming: this is a materially different scope than a pure CSS/layout pass, and the dispatch text ('this row is layout and state, not a map-engine change') is consistent with (a) -- the map engine and its data plumbing stay untouched, and the shell composes the same already-existing API for display.

getAllLayerKeys() confirmed at src/property-map-catalog.mjs:164, already the single source consumed by property-map.js's own layers panel -- no second list exists to drift, consistent with the dispatch's constraint.

Development services' 'Place' tab (web/index.html:482, 540-583) is the superseded parity design (_design/smartcity-place-tab/) to be removed; its 'colstack rail' + region/anchor-place-map pattern is the template to generalize into a persistent rail wrapping every remaining DS tab, matching Overview's existing region/anchor-overview-map pattern (web/index.html:408-435).
plan: 1. Decide and implement property-detail/records composition as (a) above: shell fetches GET /api/property-map/summary for the current gold parcel per pack and renders sc-kit panels; narrow the iframe to map-only.

2. Replace the two-button Expand/Full affordance with an explicit three-segment Dock/Expand/Full control, and give the map stage its own in-place reflow behavior (no scrim/dim, nav+tabs stay visible) separate from review/files' shared modal MountStage path.
